text: 汇率波动率长期处于如此低的水平，以至于交易员开始将其视为一种新常态，而非暂时现象。本周在阿姆斯特丹举行的年度行业会议上，低波动环境连续第二年成为主要议题之一。投资者形容，当前市场即使债券、油价和地缘政治局势出现剧烈变化，也依然难以引发汇率持续大幅波动。“我们感叹的是汇率波动率正在经历长期的趋势性下降，”系统性趋势跟踪基金AlphaEngine Global Investment Solutions联席首席投资官Harish Neelakandan表示。“这就是我们面对的现实，我们必须学会适应。”
text_en: Exchange rate volatility has been at such a low level for so long that traders have begun to regard it as a new normal rather than a temporary phenomenon. At this week's annual industry conference in Amsterdam, the low-volatility environment became one of the main topics for the second consecutive year. Investors described the current market as one in which even sharp changes in bonds, oil prices, and geopolitics still find it difficult to trigger sustained large exchange rate fluctuations. "What we lament is that exchange rate volatility is undergoing a long-term structural decline," said Harish Neelakandan, co-chief investment officer of systematic trend-following fund AlphaEngine Global Investment Solutions. "This is the reality we face, and we must learn to adapt."
